summary: All four models produced a complete set (13 images each, 1K, same prompts and pipeline) for $2.48 in total. GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst gave the most realistic and physically believable maps and is the only one with true transparency. Nano Banana 2.1 is the best value: 35% cheaper, twice as fast, and nearly as good, with a couple of height-map glitches. FLUX 3 and Qwen Image 3 Pro line up well on paper, but their height and roughness maps are mostly grayscale copies of the albedo, and FLUX drew the wrong subject for the buds. Seedream 5.0 Pro refused the subject.

gpt.notes: Best realism on every material: frosty buds with orange pistils, ridged hairy stem, varied soil. Height maps are real relief, not copies of the albedo. Only model with native transparency for the leaf. Most expensive and second slowest.

gemini.notes: Best value and fastest (~47 s per material). Very natural leaf and the richest soil. Stem height map has a hard rectangular glitch and drifted from the albedo (structure 0.38); bud height has a few bright blobs.

flux.notes: Good leaf, slightly olive. Bud texture is the wrong subject (succulent-like rosettes in an obvious grid), stem looks like a barcode, soil repeats diagonally. Height/roughness are near-copies of the albedo, which is why its alignment numbers look high.

qwen.notes: Realistic dense buds and decent soil. Leaf translucency has yellow blotches that read as disease. Maps are soft, mostly desaturated albedo. Slowest by far (526 s).

blocked.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
blocked.notes: Refused at the first request: "blocked this request through content moderation" (the subject is cannabis). Not charged.
